# Detection method to eliminate Sybil attacks in Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks
Zhaoyi Zhang, Yingxu Lai, Ye Chen, Jingwen Wei, Yuhang Wang · Ad Hoc Networks 2023 · https://doi.org/10.1016/j.adhoc.2023.103092 · relevance: high · basis: abstract

**Problem:** Sybil nodes generated by attackers disrupt normal vehicles' communication and trajectories.
**Approach:** On-board computers estimate true transmission distance from BSM timing, compare with surrounding positions to estimate the physical source per pseudonym, and integrate estimates to classify pseudonyms and identify the real malicious node.
**Tools and scale:** Simulation scenario (details not in abstract).
**Results:** Accurately detects Sybil nodes and identifies actual malicious vehicles (no figures in abstract).
**Limitations and future work (as stated by the authors):**
- None stated in abstract.
**Overlap with our engine:** partial — per-pseudonym physical-layer source estimation.
**Novelty implications:** Physical-level Sybil attribution exists.
